# What's Changed
## Repo Updates
* Type all reposititory update items here.
* Changes like wiki changes, README changes, enviroment changes, etc all count.
* Paths that count toward repo updates:
* *.md
* docs/*
* .\*/\* (i.e. .vscode, .github)
* LICENSE
* CODEOWNERS
* .* (i.e. .gitignore)
* i.e. updated README to reflect...
* anything else in the root of the repo
## Module Updates 
* Type all module update items here.
* Changes to anything within the src/ folder count as module updates.
* i.e. Updated \_\_init__.py to ...
## Dependency updates
* This is mostly handled by dependabot.
* You can just copy and paste any PRs regarding dependency updates to here.
* If manual updates were added, type them here too.
* **THE LIBRARY ITSELF UPDATING DOES NOT COUNT!**
* i.e. Bumped actions/checkout from v4 to v6 (#PR NUMBER)

This section is optional. Useful for security updates, reasoning for yanking, fix reasons for fatal bugs, etc.
